title: Working Paper
pitch: A LaTeX-style working paper with one reading level for the whole page (Abstract, Brief, Full, Appendix) that rewrites the text in place.
bestFor: Quantitative or methodological findings that readers check: derivations, numbered equations, booktabs tables, numbered references, and readers who stop at different depths (the founder reads the Abstract, the engineer reads Full).
weakness: A long single column with little visual pull; dense on a phone at Full or Appendix; the typographic evidence code (italic vs roman) is subtle.
signals: derivations or formulas the reader should be able to check
a cost or sizing model with a handful of inputs
conflicting published figures to reconcile with arithmetic
audiences that need different depths of the same argument
avoid: dashboards or status updates to scan
answers that depend on time or phases
many parts whose relationships are the point (use a map or canvas)
short, mostly qualitative reports with no numbers to check
